Retrospective published data comparison, not prospective independent project calibration.

Fixed 10-second solver output grid is interpolated at irregular measurement timestamps within support; interpolation error is not separately calibrated.
Mesh sensitivity is not a general convergence-order proof, safety, life or runaway qualification.
